mapper.select: SELECT college_id AS collegeId, college_name AS collegeName, college_code AS collegeCode, total_points AS totalPoints, gold_count AS goldCount, silver_count AS silverCount, bronze_count AS bronzeCount, individual_points AS individualPoints, team_points AS teamPoints, ranking AS ranking FROM v_college_ranking ORDER BY ranking ASC

SELECT college_id AS collegeId, college_name AS collegeName, college_code AS collegeCode, total_points AS totalPoints, gold_count AS goldCount, silver_count AS silverCount, bronze_count AS bronzeCount, individual_points AS individualPoints, team_points AS teamPoints, ranking AS ranking FROM v_college_ranking WHERE college_id = #{collegeId}

SELECT e.id AS eventId, e.name AS eventName, CASE WHEN s.team_participation_id IS NOT NULL THEN '团体' ELSE '个人' END AS eventType, a.name AS athleteName, s.`rank` AS `rank`, s.score_display AS score, s.points AS points FROM as_score s LEFT JOIN as_competition cp ON s.competition_id = cp.id AND cp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN as_event e ON cp.event_id = e.id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN as_participation p ON s.participation_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN as_athlete a ON p.athlete_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND (s.college_id = #{collegeId} OR a.college_id = #{collegeId}) ORDER BY s.points DESC
